subject: Next steps: vendor questionnaire route (SIG vs CAIQ) and evidence ask
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medalign.com>, MedAlign Security <security@medalign.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick recap + questionnaire route recommendation

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Ask from your side: we should confirm whether MedAlign wants us to kick off a SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) questionnaire or submit a CAIQ/Registry alternative for faster completion. From the call I heard: prefer SIG for thoroughness, but CAIQ is acceptable if turnaround needs to be faster. Can you confirm preference?

- Compliance scope clarifications we need before prefilling: SOC 2 status (Type II in place? report date), HIPAA coverage (PHI in scope for this integration?), and any EU residency/GDPR constraints for data stores.

- Evidence/priority items you called out: encryption (in-transit & at-rest), SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, subprocessor list. We can provide an initial prefill (SIG-lite) plus a mapping of artifacts we can share.

Proposed next steps: if SIG is preferred, we’ll send a prefilled SIG workbook + evidence checklist by end of week and schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through gaps. If CAIQ is preferred, we can generate that faster and mark items for follow-up.

I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and a draft SIG prefill worksheet for your review. Can you share the best contact for legal/SOC2 report intake (you mentioned Natalie on the call)?

Thanks — Mateo

Attachments: redwood_sig-prefill.xlsx (prefill workbook), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page blurb)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medalign.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedAlign Security <security@medalign.com>, Natalie Park <natalie.legal@medalign.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RE: Quick recap + questionnaire route recommendation

Thanks Mateo — appreciated the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Preference: SIG would be ideal (we need the depth for our InfoSec review), but if Redwood can provide a CAIQ completed in parallel for our procurement team, that speeds approvals. So both together would be great.

- Compliance: MedAlign has SOC 2 Type II (most recent report issued 2025-11-01) and we are HIPAA-covered for the product scope you discussed (PHI will be in-scope for certain APIs). We will need to see controls/evidence around encryption, key management, logging/audit trails, and subprocessor names.

- Timeline: Legal wants SOC2 document + SIG prefill by EOW (we’re working to get Natalie looped in for signed NDA / secure report exchange). Security also dropped a network diagram for context — attached.

Natalie (cc’d) is the legal contact for evidence intake and will coordinate receiving the SOC2 report and any DPAs. Security team — please add any immediate asks.

Sarah

Attachment: medalign_prod_network_diagram.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medalign.com>
Cc: Natalie Park <natalie.legal@medalign.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, MedAlign Security <security@medalign.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Re: RE: Quick recap + questionnaire route recommendation

Thanks — great, and helpful that SOC2 is already Type II. A couple quick clarifying questions before we finalize the prefill: 

1) SOC2 sharing: will Natalie accept the standard SOC2 secure exchange (we can provide via our secure file transfer) or do you require a signed NDA first? If NDA, can you share the template or should we send ours?

2) Encryption : you mentioned KMS — are you expecting us to provide KMS vendor details + config notes (we can summarize keys-in-use and rotation policy) or will a controls narrative + screenshot suffice initially?

3) Subprocessors: do you need the full current list or just those used for production inference (we can supply both but want to set expectations on maintenance cadence).

Proposed internal deliverables from Redwood this week: 1) SIG prefill (xlsx) 2) CAIQ export (if helpful) 3) Evidence map (SOC2 + pen-test + network diagram + encryption notes) 4) Short 30-min sync — I’ve proposed times here: https://cal.com/mateo/redwood-medalign-30m

If that sounds good I’ll ask Kimberly and Jordan to start assembling the evidence bundle and mapping.

— Mateo

Kimberly / Jordan — forwarding MedAlign thread. They prefer SIG, will accept CAIQ in parallel, and need SOC2 + prefill by EOW. Key asks: encryption controls (in-transit & at-rest), KMS vendor/rotation notes, pen-test summary, and subprocessor list. They attached a network diagram.

- Kimberly: build the SIG prefill (use attached workbook I started) and pull SOC2/pen-test artifacts we can share (redacted where necessary). Confirm whether we need an NDA before sending SOC2 (Natalie asked).

Thanks — Mateo
